paragraphs: On Friday, October second, the school hall had a book sale. Long tables stood in lines, and every table was full of books. At a quarter to two, Mia, Leo, May, and Lily came in. A big sign was on the wall. It said, "BOOK SALE: COMICS TWENTY BAHT. STORY BOOKS THIRTY BAHT. QUIZ AND PUZZLE BOOKS FORTY BAHT." "ALL HALF-PRICE AFTER TWO O'CLOCK."

Leo took a comic from a table. "How much does this comic cost?" he asked. "Twenty baht," said May. "And how much is a story book?" asked Mia. "If it is a story book, it costs thirty baht," said Lily. "A quiz book is more expensive," said May. She held up a big quiz book. "This one has a hundred questions," she said. "I hate puzzles, but I like quiz books." "I like comics," said Leo. "I prefer story books," said Mia. "This one has a lovely picture on the front." Mia looked at the sign again. "If we wait until two o'clock, everything is half-price," she said.

"But I want my comic now!" said Leo. "It is only fifteen minutes," said Lily. "Look at the clock, Leo." The friends walked around the tables for fifteen minutes. Leo read the first page of a comic and laughed. At two o'clock, a girl in a school uniform rang a small bell. "It's two o'clock!" she said. "Everything is half-price now." "If you want to pay, stand in the line at the end of the hall."

Leo gave the girl a coin and paid ten baht for his comic. May paid twenty baht for her quiz book. Mia paid thirty baht for two story books. Lily counted the money for the blog. "The total is sixty baht," she said. "A comic, a quiz book, and two story books for only sixty baht!" Leo laughed and held his comic. "This is the best sale," he said.
